target_customer: AI labs and enterprises that need realistic enterprise environments, codebases and datasets for training and evaluating agents
problem: Frontier AI progress is bottlenecked by hard to access data from real businesses.
business_model: Dataset licensing and evaluation benchmark as a sales channel (per press commentary)
product_category: AI training data, environments and benchmarks

founders.name: Siddhant Paliwal
previous_startups: Founded his first company at 15 (name not given on YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Acquiring and licensing private codebases and operational data, then building tasks and a leaderboard, is hard on the sourcing side more than the engineering side.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive licensed company data and codebases can be hard to replicate, but relationships with data sources and buyer concentration among a few AI labs are fragile.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Not verified which data vendors competed in 2025.

market_need_then: AI labs were spending heavily on training environments and evaluation data in 2025. The company launched Real-SWE on 2026-09-12 and coverage in the trade press followed.

branding.domain_note: Uses withspecific.com since the plain name was taken; legal entity is still Bear AI Inc. according to a profile. A same batch YC company is named Specific.

identity.voice_and_tone: Research lab voice with benchmarks and leaderboards.

rebrands.why: Pivot from AI search visibility tracking to enterprise data and environments; exact date and reasons not found

branding.community_and_virality: Real-SWE received coverage from The New Stack, Born City and several newsletters around 2026-09.

brand_strength.rationale: Real-SWE gave the brand press attention, but the generic name collides with Specific (specific.dev) and several others, and the company has rebranded once.

pivots.from: Bear: tool to track and improve brand mentions in AI search and agent recommendations (60+ customers including Cal.com and Browserbase per YC launch)
pivots.to: Specific Labs: enterprise environments, datasets and Real-SWE benchmark
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; a profile says they pivoted again from earlier positioning

outcome_analysis: The company entered YC in Fall 2025 as Bear, a generative engine optimization product with 60 plus customers, and later became Specific Labs selling real world enterprise environments and datasets for AI. Real-SWE in September 2026 brought press attention. Funding is not verified and the pivot is too recent to judge whether the data business works.
notes: The website withspecific.com could not be fetched (safety check rate limited). Dealroom lists a 125K seed, while VCBacked and CB Insights style listings about 500K pre-seed, and some aggregator pages mix this company with Specific (specific.dev); none verified so no round recorded. The competitor list is empty because search found only 2025 to 2026 GEO market lists tied to the earlier Bear product and no dated sources for the data business. The pivot date is only known to be before 2026-09 and is recorded as 2026 without a month; it could be earlier.
